More tools can make an AI agent less capable.

If every testing feature becomes a separate MCP tool, the model spends context reading the catalogue before the real task begins.

VirtuProbe keeps the tool surface fixed, then lets the agent discover the one typed capability it needs.

Ten capabilities or a thousand: the starting cost stays stable.

A better agent doesn’t need a bigger menu. It needs a sharper one.

https://virtuprobe.studio/
